honest.source: written for this experiment: started / may have completed / not confirmed stopped / check state first; nothing only a human could do
honest.text: Outcome unknown: the command started and may have completed its effects before it was stopped, and the process could not be confirmed stopped. Check the current state before deciding whether to run it again.
